offence_note: Break and enter dwelling, use of imitation firearm, theft over $5,000
sentence_quote: On Count 1 regarding the break and entry, I sentence you to four years. On Count 4 regarding the imitation gun, that is a statutory sentence of one year.
note: Four years plus consecutive one year; theft one year concurrent.

sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, set aside the sentence, and substitute a sentence of six months less one day.
note: Sentence reduced from nine months because of immigration consequences.

offence_note: Robbery using a firearm in home invasion
co_offenders: Wright: 18 months imprisonment (5 years before credit) then 2 years probation
sentence_quote: As a result, in the absence of pre-trial custody, I would impose on Mr. Deadder a sentence of six-and-a-half years, and Mr. Wright a sentence of five years.
note: Actual sentence 3 years for Deadder after pre-trial custody; credit amount not stated; probation and no-contact apply to Wright.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted, the appeal is allowed and for the sentence imposed is substituted a 12-month sentence.
note: Reduced from 18 months; FASD noted as personal circumstance.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking and production of marihuana
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that in this case it is appropriate to impose a conditional sentence of imprisonment for a period of 12 months with the following conditions.
note: Conditional sentence with house arrest and 50 hours community work.

offence_note: First-degree murder and twelve counts of robbery
sentence_quote: Since the sentence imposed was the mandatory minimum, there is no right of appeal. I would quash the sentence appeal.
note: Sentence not stated; life and 25 years parole ineligibility inferred from mandatory minimum for first-degree murder.

sentence_quote: However, we cannot say that a six-month custodial sentence for this offence was unfit.
note: Trial judge erred treating refusal to accept responsibility as aggravating; sentence still upheld.

offence_note: Sexual assault and failure to comply with undertaking
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal, quash the sentence imposed at trial and, along with it, the pleas of guilty entered there.
note: Sentence of 12 months plus probation quashed for lack of jurisdiction; remitted to Ontario Court of Justice.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, weapon for dangerous purpose, threats, mischief
sentence_quote: We would allow the appeal, set aside the LTO designation, and affirm the sentence of nine years imposed by the sentencing judge.
note: Long-term offender designation and 10-year supervision order set aside; nine-year term affirmed.

sentence_quote: Accordingly the appeal is allowed but only to remove the victim fine surcharge.
note: Joint submission of 18 months on top of pre-trial custody upheld; only surcharge removed.
